routing: Switching is per channel at each egress degree. A line-wide impairment on an ingress degree therefore continues as a per-channel impairment on each channel routed onward.
troubleshooting_notes: None for the failure modes below. These faults are seen through OCM readings and through alarms on the downstream transponders.
A single-channel power deviation on the OCM points to the node where the deviation first appears.
A port failure is located at the ingress port of the affected degree; a single-channel fault at that channel on the ingress port of the degree where it first appears.
